name: Banh tet la cam
summary: Bánh tét lá cẩm is a purple bánh tét, coloured with lá cẩm, made in Bình Thủy. It is the Can Tho cake to give at Tết or carry home as a gift.
howToEat: Slice it, or buy one to carry home.
seoTitle: Banh tet la cam from Binh Thuy
seoDescription: Purple bánh tét coloured with lá cẩm, a Can Tho gift cake from Bình Thủy.
